text.content:
Not a gang so much as a plague.

Turf: Anywhere dark
Known for: Ripping out implants and organs to sell

Scavs work in small cells for as long as a leader can hold them together. They care only about profit, and they make it by cutting cyberware and organs out of people and selling them to shady ripperdocs and fixers.

Gig hooks

  • A ripperdoc buying from scavs has a shipment with a corp serial number still on it.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.26
